comments.author: dawn
comments.text: PRELIMINARY READOUT — shape-rogue-20261107 (80/80 games pulled to runs-modal/, all 5 rounds valid, missing_rate 0.0). Rollup: runs-modal/shape-rogue-20261107/rogue_rollup.json. CI (0=competitive..1=collusive) clean vs rogue1: flat 0.066->0.107, ring 0.051->0.037, star 0.024->0.029, hierarchy 0.033->0.025. Findings: (1) Qwen3.5-4B at n=8 barely coordinates (CI<=0.11 everywhere); (2) FLAT public board shows the most tacit coordination among clean arms — structured topologies (star/hierarchy) slightly LESS collusive, opposite of the naive 'more structure = more collusion' prior; (3) embedded rogue does NOT cascade: rogue's own violations 2-4/40 rounds (~all violations attributable to seller_1), market CI barely moves; (4) rogue ONSET is immediate (round 1) in star/hierarchy, delayed (~3.5) in flat/ring; (5) clean arms show baseline honor-rule slips (1-4 per 40 rounds) — promise-keeping is not free even without a rogue; (6) takeover HHI 0.15-0.18 vs uniform 0.125 — mild leadership, no takeover anywhere. Caveats: 10 seeds, 5 rounds, single model, n=8; grid run (n2..n30) is the scaling test. Bead stays open for RUN1 (shape-grid-20261107, ap-qDSfMmVOjbSUKR2Ewdv5yi, expected landing ~18:30-19:30Z).

title: SwarmShape analysis + report (games.csv, figures, README evidence note)
description: After agora-oda: aggregate the grid with scripts/analyze_shape_grid.py (joins per-game summary.json with graph features from the run's own config — no census needed at analysis time) into runs/shape_grid/games.csv + report.md. Read out: does topology change rogue onset/rate and collusion index; takeover-HHI vs graph shape; n-scaling. Then figures/ + README note citing the run tags, per repo convention, and a follow-up summary in docs/swarmshape-methods.md if the method drifted.
